title: Contours, a profile and cut-and-fill for a hypothetical platform on a hillside near Mahd adh Dhahab, from NASADEM

headline.label: of cut at the balanced platform level

data: NASADEM_HGT version 001 by NASA JPL (2020): 1 arc-second (about 30 m) elevations from the SRTM flight of February 2000, in whole metres above the EGM96 geoid, tile n23e040.
method: A 3 × 3 km window around 40.8074° E, 23.5114° N, about 7 km west of Mahd adh Dhahab (EPSG:32637), resampled bilinearly to 5 m and 30 m cells.
Contours every 10 m with an index line every 50 m, from the 5 m grid.
A hypothetical 150 × 100 m platform with its long side along the contours; the fall line under it from the mean gradient.
Balanced level: the mean ground elevation inside the platform, so cut equals fill.
limits: The platform is hypothetical and for illustration only; the site was not chosen for any project. The NASADEM user guide (NASA JPL, 2020) gives the SRTM requirement as 16 m absolute vertical error at 90% and a global average absolute height error of about 6.8 m; the model is a radar surface of February 2000 in whole metres. The 5 m grid is interpolated from cells of about 30 m and adds no detail, and the platform covers only about 16 original cells.
